text:
### Rejection Scenarios  
**Account Rejected If:**
- ❌ KYC verification failed (cannot verify identity)
- ❌ AML hit (sanctions match confirmed)
- ❌ PEP/adverse media (cannot mitigate risk)
- ❌ Beneficial ownership unclear (entity customers)
- ❌ Source of funds suspicious (fraud concern)
- ❌ Regulatory exception denied  
**Rejection Notification:**
- Written notice to customer (no AML reason disclosed—tipping off risk)
- Letter: "We are unable to open your account at this time. Please contact us for more information."
- No detailed explanation (prevents tipping off)

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end account opening workflow that includes KYC verification, AML screening, PEP/adverse media checks, beneficial ownership verification, and source of funds assessment. Accounts are rejected if any compliance checkpoint fails, with rejection notification issued to the customer without disclosure of AML-related reasons to prevent tipping off.
context: Account Rejected If: KYC verification failed (cannot verify identity)

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification Check
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to verify customer identity during account opening. Rejection occurs if identity cannot be verified, preventing account opening.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Check
raw_entities.description: Sanctions and AML list screening step performed during account opening. Account is rejected if a confirmed sanctions match is identified.

raw_entities.name: PEP and Adverse Media Assessment
raw_entities.description: Assessment of Politically Exposed Person status and adverse media findings during account opening. Account is rejected if PEP or adverse media risk cannot be mitigated.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step to establish clear beneficial ownership, particularly for entity customers. Account is rejected if beneficial ownership cannot be clearly determined.

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Assessment
raw_entities.description: Assessment of the customer's source of funds during account opening. Account is rejected if source of funds is deemed suspicious or presents a fraud concern.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Exception Review
raw_entities.description: Review of any regulatory exceptions or exemptions that may apply to the account opening. Account is rejected if the regulatory exception is denied.

raw_entities.name: Rejection Notification
raw_entities.description: Written notification sent to customer when account opening is rejected. The notification does not disclose AML-related reasons to prevent tipping off, using a standard generic message.
context: Written notice to customer (no AML reason disclosed—tipping off risk)
Letter: "We are unable to open your account at this time. Please contact us for more information."

raw_entities.name: Account Approval Decision
raw_entities.description: Branching decision point determining whether account opening proceeds or is rejected based on compliance checkpoint outcomes. Multiple rejection criteria exist: KYC failure, AML hit, PEP/adverse media risk, unclear beneficial ownership, suspicious source of funds, or denied regulatory exception.
context: Account Rejected If: KYC verification failed (cannot verify identity)

raw_entities.name: PEP and Adverse Media Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint assessing PEP status and adverse media. Unmitigable PEP or adverse media risk results in account rejection.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint establishing clear beneficial ownership, particularly for entity customers. Unclear beneficial ownership results in account rejection.

raw_entities.description: Natural person or entity applying for account opening. Subject to KYC verification, AML screening, PEP assessment, beneficial ownership verification, and source of funds assessment. Receives rejection notification if account opening is denied.
